messages:
maria gonzalez: Heads-up — vendor asked for a pen test window next Tue–Fri. We need RBAC scope finalized, KMS access plan, and an audit-log export checklist. Can we run a quick readiness checklist?

jamal singh: +1. I can own RBAC changes. Plan is to create an ephemeral role 'pen_test_assessor' scoped to specific resources. Need the exact list of services/endpoints in-scope.

alex chen: For KMS: we should create a one-off Grant with a TTL and a presigned S3 path for evidence uploads. I can script key grants and a short-lived policy.

sophia lee: Audit notes — we'll export CloudTrail + app logs to a locked bucket and take a snapshot before the window. Object lock + separate retention account. I'll draft retention policy (suggest 365d for assessment evidence).

jamal singh: Quick Q — do assessors need SecretsManager/ListSecrets? I'd rather avoid broad list perms. Suggest a narrow proxy that returns only allowed artifact metadata.

maria gonzalez: Vendor says they need to hit inference endpoints and see request/response logs (sanitized). We'll provide a sanitized subset and a replay user. Also need change-freeze dates from infra.

sre-oncall: Deploy-bot: canary deploy scheduled Fri 03:00 UTC — pausing deploys during pen test window. :no_entry_sign: Please confirm no hotfixes planned.

security-bot: Added initial checklist entry in tracker: https://go/internal/pen-tests/track/1743219876 — update remediation owners and evidence links there.

alex chen: Terraform snippet for ephemeral role I will use (draft):

```hcl
resource "aws_iam_role" "pen_test_assessor" {
  name = "pen_test_assessor_${formatdate(\"YYYYMMDD\", timestamp())}"
  assume_role_policy = data.aws_iam_policy_document.assume_role.json
  tags = { purpose = "pen-test" }
}

resource "aws_kms_grant" "pen_test_grant" {
  key_id = var.kms_key_id
  grantee_principal = aws_iam_role.pen_test_assessor.arn
  operations = ["Decrypt", "GenerateDataKey"]
  constraints {
    encryption_context_subset = { "pen_test" = "true" }
  }
  retirement_date = timeadd(timestamp(), "168h") // 7 days
}
```

jamal singh: That looks good. I'll map roles to specific API routes and models — aim to avoid any wildcard resources.

sophia lee: For evidence export, run this to pull CloudTrail for the window: `aws s3 cp s3://cloudtrail-logs/2026/03/ --recursive /tmp/ct-snapshot/` then bundle & upload to presigned path. I'll add the exact commands in tracker.

maria gonzalez: Retest criteria proposal: remediation PR merged + staging deployment + reproduction steps in a locked doc + audit export showing no exploit events for the problematic vectors. Thoughts?

jamal singh: Agree. Also add a requirement for unit/e2e test demonstrating the fix where possible. I'll create the remediation epic and link to the tracker.

sophia lee: Proposed retest window = 7 days after remediation signoff. Require CloudTrail export + SIEM query showing zero matched alerts for the CVE IDs.

maria gonzalez: Action items: jamal — RBAC mapping and ephemeral role creation; alex — KMS grants + presigned upload flow; sophia — audit export scripts & bucket policy; maria (me) — vendor coordination and change-freeze note. Ping me by EOD Monday.

alex chen: I'll put the KMS grant PR in draft and add the presigned upload lambda. ETA Monday midday.

jamal singh: Opening remediation epic now and assigning owners. Will post ticket link in tracker.

sophia lee: I'll sync with SRE on object-lock and cross-account copy for extra assurance.

maria gonzalez: Thanks — if anyone hits blockers comment in the tracker thread and tag @maria gonzalez. :thumbsup:
